analysis: Both supplied units are base-text excerpts of CHANGELOG.md (lines 395 onward and 610 onward). No diff hunk or added/removed lines were supplied, so I could not tell which lines the PR changed. The text is documentation only and has no executable or configuration effect. Its release-history entries describe controls already in the threat model: App Attest serving authorization and revocation fencing (A-016, A-017, T-052 to T-058, TB-011), the encrypted SSD prefix cache and its disk and TTL policy (T-041), account-scoped cache salts, and MDM-optional removal gating. No claim in the excerpts contradicts the canonical model. One mismatch is noted, not reported as a finding: the changelog's v0.9.1 and later entries describe the SSD disk budget as half of available disk without a fixed ceiling, with a 20 GiB reserve. This matches the T-041 text. Another is the changelog's 'Raise the default shared SSD cache ceiling to 100 GiB' entry under v0.9.0 candidates, which is historical and is superseded by the v0.9.1 entry. The changelog says the SSD cache TTL is not mentioned in these units, so the 30-minute TTL in T-041 is neither confirmed nor contradicted. Because the patch is not visible, I cannot confirm what the PR changed in CHANGELOG.md. Any security-relevant code or threat-model changes in other files of this PR need review in their own units.
